topic: AI's Impact on Search and Content Strategy
headline: From content creation to content orchestration: How agentic AI changes the role of content strategists.
keyNotes: Advanced computer programs, referred to as "agentic AI," are changing how businesses create their online materials, moving beyond just making things.
Instead of simply producing content, these smart programs are helping to manage and direct the entire process, which the article calls "orchestration."
This shift means that people whose job it is to plan what a company puts out online (called "strategists") will have new responsibilities and different tasks.
Even with these advanced computer programs taking on more, it's still absolutely necessary for humans to supervise and guide what the AI does.
question: The article emphasizes that "essential human oversight" is still needed even with advanced AI. In your own field, what specific aspects of your work do you believe will always require human judgment and supervision, no matter how smart technology becomes?
